mapper.select: SELECT s.industry, COUNT(*) AS stockCount, ROUND(AVG(d.change_percent),2) AS avgChangePct, ROUND(AVG(s.pe),2) AS avgPe FROM stock s LEFT JOIN stock_daily d ON s.stock_code = d.stock_code AND d.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_daily) WHERE s.industry IS NOT NULL AND s.industry != '' GROUP BY s.industry ORDER BY stockCount DESC
